records.observation: Both actual L5→L6 campaign handovers: normal opening shows warm furnishings mostly empty, while24 residents cluster in standing rows on the tracks beyond. Explicit overview shows the carried cohort all upright/gesturing; no seated, lying, treatment or sharing presentation, despite corresponding assigned routine labels. Source IDs and fullHP retained. This is not the L6-default preset.
